newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK police break up heroin ring, seize Ecstasy pills.
newsitem.headline: HK police break up heroin ring, seize Ecstasy pills.

text.p: Hong Kong police said on Thursday they and seized four kg (8.8 pounds) of heroin with a street value of HK$8.4 million ($1.08 million).

The news followed a separate announcement on Thursday that police had seized 30,000 tablets of Ecstasy with a street value of HK$9 million ($1.16 million) -- the largest quantity of the designer drug ever found in the British territory.
In the heroin seizure, police said they had smashed a drug syndicate and arrested two men in Kowloon district. One was arrested as he emerged from a taxi carrying a bag, they said.
Four men were arrested in connection to the Ecstasy bust. Police said the tablets were imported from the Netherlands.
Ecstasy is a synthetic stimulant popular on the dance club scene.
